resolution_notes: Disputed fields free_tier_limits and rate_limits: Verifier A is correct. Official NVD docs (https://nvd.nist.gov/developers/request-an-api-key) state rolling window limits of 5 requests per 30 seconds without an API key and 50 requests per 30 seconds with a free API key. Original "unknown" / "not published" are wrong; Verifier B incorrectly confirmed them. All other fields keep original (null).
free_tier_limits: Without API key: 5 requests / 30 seconds. With free API key: 50 requests / 30 seconds.
rate_limits: Without API key: 5 requests / 30 seconds. With free API key: 50 requests / 30 seconds.
